# ankra_aws_regions (Data Source)

The AWS regions enabled for an AWS credential, to pick `region` on `ankra_aws_cluster`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_aws_regions" "account" {
  credential_id = ankra_aws_role_credential.main.id
}

output "aws_regions" {
  value = data.ankra_aws_regions.account.regions[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.

### Read-Only

- `incomplete_reasons` (List of String) Why `pricing_complete` is false; empty when it is true.
- `pricing_complete` (Boolean) Whether the platform could read prices for the account's regions.
- `regions` (Attributes List) Enabled regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Region code, e.g. `eu-central-1`.
